content.en: Sustainable agriculture focuses on **resource efficiency**, **soil health**, and **biodiversity conservation**. In the context of the **Indian Economy**, it aims to reduce dependency on chemical inputs, thereby lowering production costs for small and marginal farmers while ensuring ecological resilience.
